content.text: Shouldn't the `WildcardExceptionMapper` catch this now?
The WildcardExceptionMapper catches top-level exceptions, but there are many scenarios that result in an unformatted HTML stacktrace.
What kind of throwable is escaping that mapper? Doesn't it catch `RuntimeException`?
As you can see, the WildcardExceptionMapper returns a stacktrace:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/master/fcrepo-http-commons/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/http/commons/exceptionhandlers/WildcardExceptionMapper.java#L60
This ticket is to address the fact that we do not want to inflict an unformatted stacktrace in the HTML view, hence the "top-level error page".
Did you notice the flag in that mapper for exactly that?
Boolean showStackTrace
The stacktrace is nice. This ticket is not trying to get rid of the stacktrace.
This ticket is to address the fact that we do not want to inflict an unformatted stacktrace in the HTML view, hence the "top-level error page".
I don't understand what you are talking about, but it doesn't matter, since I'm not going to take this ticket.
Didn't see a stracktrace to the browser after follow the description in
https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-1766
. So what is this ticket about?
, As noted in comments on FCREPO-1766, it would appear that you did not exactly following the steps in that ticket for reproducing the error.
please see
https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-1766?focusedCommentId=45781&page=com.atlassian.jira.plugin.system.issuetabpanels:comment-tabpanel#comment-45781
, here is an example of an error scenario that is caught and displayed in the HTML UI within a pop-up window:
Create a container in the HTML UI
Use the "Update Properties" field to make this update:

INSERT { <> junk:comment "hello"}
WHERE { }
, you may also find it helpful in understanding how the error pop-up works by examining:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/master/fcrepo-http-api/src/main/resources/views/common.js#L257
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/master/fcrepo-http-api/src/main/resources/views/common.js#L349
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/master/fcrepo-http-api/src/main/resources/views/common-header.vsl#L53-L69
...possibly (#errorModal) handlers should be added elsewhere in the vsl code.
, is this still something you are going to work on? Thanks!
This task is to create a top-level HTML view that will catch all otherwise uncaught stacktraces.
For example, the error seen in the following scenario should not result in a stracktrace to the browser:
